responsibility: Implements the Rust frontend AST pass that scans outer attributes for `#[lang = ...]` markers and records the corresponding node IDs in `Analysis::Mappings` before lowering. It validates attribute names, diagnoses unknown attributes on visited items, parses the lang-item string into `LangItem::Kind`, and handles the concrete AST item forms that can define lang items such as traits, associated types, functions, structs, and enums, so this file is the executable collection step that seeds later name resolution and semantic handling of compiler-known language items.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable AST pass for lang-item collection: attribute parsing/validation, conversion of `#[lang = ...]` strings to `LangItem::Kind`, and the visitor bodies that insert matching node IDs into `Analysis::Mappings`. Unlike the paired header, this `.cc` file performs the actual scan and diagnostics rather than just declaring the pass.
